lines.text: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God," and the corrupt do no good.
God looks down from heaven on the sons of men to see if any understand and seek God.
All have turned away and together become corrupt, and no one does good, not even one.
The workers of iniquity devour God's people like bread, and they are overwhelmed with hunger where there was nothing to fear.
David longs for salvation to come from Bethel, and when God restores His captive people, Jacob will rejoice.
